title: Indiana State Fair Replaces Two Free Stage Concerts - NewsBreak
text:
By Bobby G. ,
2 hours ago
Why the Indiana State Fair Changed Its Concert Lineup The Indiana State Fair recently announced that two acts originally scheduled to perform on the Hoosier Lottery Free Stage would NOT be able to perform in 2026. And to make up for the sudden change, the fair is adding two new replacement acts for those nights!
The first change to the lineup is on day one of the 2026 Indiana State Fair. The Beach Boys will not be performing in 2026 as originally planned, as their show has been postponed and will now take place in 2027. So, who is stepping up to fill those big shoes?
The Four Tops | Friday, August 7th Indiana State Fair The Four Tops became Motown legends after breaking through with “Baby I Need Your Loving” in 1964, followed by a string of hits including “I Can’t Help Myself (Sugar Pie, Honey Bunch),” “Reach Out I’ll Be There,” and “Bernadette.” The iconic group was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 1990.
The Spinners | Friday, August 7th Indiana State Fair The Spinners first found national success at Motown with “It’s a Shame,” a Stevie Wonder-produced hit that launched the group’s rise to R&B stardom. With millions of records sold, 18 Gold and Platinum albums, six Grammy nominations, a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, and a 2023 induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, the Spinners remain one of music’s most celebrated vocal groups.
The other change to the concert schedule is Wednesday, August 12th, when Bret Michaels was scheduled to perform. He is unable to make it to Indianapolis, so two great rock bands will take his place.
Warrant | Wednesday, August 12th Indiana State Fair Warrant exploded onto the rock scene in 1989 with a string of hit songs including “Down Boys,” “Cherry Pie,” “Heaven,” and “I Saw Red.” Their power ballad “Heaven” reached No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 1 on the Rolling Stone chart, helping cement the band’s multiplatinum success.
Vixen | Wednesday, August 12th Indiana State Fair There’s only one female rock band from the 80s who sold over two million albums worldwide, had six #1 videos on MTV and four songs chart in Billboard’s Top 100, and that band is VIXEN.
The 2026 Indiana State Fair runs from August 7th through August 23rd (closed Mondays), and all of these concerts are included with your admission.
Here is the full, updated lineup of Concerts for the 2026 Hoosier Lottery Free Stage at the Indiana State Fair:
The Four Tops and The Spinners – Friday, August 7 TUSK – The Classic Fleetwood Mac Tribute – Saturday, August 8 Josiah Queen – Sunday, August 9 Clayton Anderson – Tuesday, August 11 Warrant with special guests Vixen – Wednesday, August 12 Busta Rhymes – Thursday, August 13 Grand Funk Railroad – Friday, August 14 DJ Golden Hour: A Tribute to Demon Hunters – Saturday, August 15 Trace Adkins – Sunday, August 16 Los Sementales De Nuevo Leon – Tuesday, August 18 Happy Together Tour- Wednesday, August 19 Gene Simmons – Thursday, August 20 Sammy Kershaw & Craig Morgan – Friday, August 21 Don McLean – Saturday, August 22 Tasha Cobbs Leonard – Sunday, August 23 Click here to view photo gallery 2
